protocol_name: Phase 23 Frame-Level Reconstruction and Paired Failure Atlas Study Protocol

evaluation_rules.confidence_handling: unfiltered predictions above conf=0.001 matched to ground truth; no threshold tuning on test set
evaluation_rules.tp_definition: predicted box with match_iou >= 0.50 against an unmatched ground truth target
evaluation_rules.fp_definition: predicted box with match_iou < 0.50 or matching an already-matched ground truth target
evaluation_rules.fn_definition: ground truth target without any matched prediction with match_iou >= 0.50
evaluation_rules.frame_success_definition: tp >= 1 and fn == 0 (successful localization of target)

RECOVERED.description: Detector recovered landing pad detection where baseline failed

REGRESSED.description: Detector lost landing pad detection where baseline succeeded

BOTH_PASS.description: Both detectors correctly localized the landing pad

BOTH_FAIL.description: Both detectors failed to localize the landing pad

evaluation_rules.missing_data_behavior: strict: any missing view, frame, or condition raises an error and halts execution

paired_binary_test.applied_to: Per-condition and overall binary success paired contingency tables
paired_binary_test.correction: Continuity correction applied; exact binomial calculation when discordant count (b + c) < 25

tests: Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test for IoU differences (Phase 23 - Baseline)
Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test for confidence differences (Phase 23 - Baseline)

clustered_bootstrap.description: Accounts for repeated observations across 6 conditions per source frame by resampling whole source frames with replacement
